# Indie Hackers Interviews

A launch platform: listings get a day (or week) in the spotlight, so timing and the first comment matter.

Notes from the directory list: Pitch a founder interview once you have revenue.

## Steps
1. Open https://www.indiehackers.com/interviews and find the tips/submission form or the right editor's contact.
2. Write a pitch from `copy.press_pitch` with one hook specific to this outlet (under 150 words, skill/human-writing).
3. `launchkit draft indie-hackers-interviews -` and mark `drafted`. Submit a web form only if `pitch` mode is enabled and the user approved it.

## Make the listing perform
- Pick the earliest free launch slot on or after the user's preferred launch date. Never pay to skip the queue unless the user approved it.
- Use `copy.maker_comment` as the first comment. Reply to every comment on launch day (tell the user).
- Use the best screenshot first. The thumbnail decides whether people click.
